PP model comparisons

This is a comparison of variations of BIOv2 with BIOv1 and VGPM, using the same input data as BIOv1. Input is from monthly composites, output is total daily primary production (mg C / m2 / day), averaged over the month. Note that with the exception of the MODIS cloud cover fraction used in BIO_v1, all of these models use data from VIIRS-SNPP.

First, the PI parameters alphaB and PmB, along with log10(chl) are mapped to show spatial patterns that influence models BIOv1 and BIOv2_VPI_NU. Second, BIOv1 and VGPM models are mapped, and variations of the new models:

  1. VPI_NU - variable PI parameters (i.e. allowed to vary pixel-to-pixel) with nonuniform biomass profile (biomass profile parameters also vary by pixel)
  2. MPI_U - median PI parameters of the whole region, and uniform biomass profile

Finally, the percent difference between the new model and BIOv1 and VGPM are mapped, with a table of Pearson’s correlation coefficients between percent difference and three variables: chla, latitude, bathymetry. Note that the x-axis range of the density plots is the mean +- 2stdev.

% difference = (100 * (BIOv2 - y) / y)
y = BIOv1 or VGPM
